faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful for any person knowingly, recklessly, or with criminal negligence
               to poison any domesticated animal or livestock, or to knowingly distribute or set
               out poison or any other toxicant anywhere within the city in any manner whatsoever
               that causes the poisoning of any such animal. The distribution or setting out of any
               poison, toxicant, or poisoned meat or food, other than those specifically for insect,
               bat, rat, mouse, or other rodent poisoning, shall be prima facie evidence of violation
               of this section. The poisoning of insects, bats, rats, mice, and other rodents shall
               conform with all applicable state and federal laws.
(Code 1981, § 6-77; Ord. No. 3496, § 2, 12-14-1998)
